_comment: Sea fights on the water (systems/seaFights.js) and royal squadrons on the world map (world/navySquadrons.js). Any key left out keeps the code's default. fight.boarding: hand to hand when nobody is watching — (crew + guns x guns) x drill x hull, to the power exponent; the ship boarded fights from her own deck (x defend); kind multiplies by who she is (own = your ships, merchant, pirate, navy). fight.ai: the enemy and the sailing master board at boardAt odds, a hurt ship (hull < 45) at boardHurt; pirates after 15 s at pirateBoardAt, a prey under 70 hull at pirateBoardHurt, cruel ones dare cruelNerve more; a ship tries to rake only when she turns at least rakeHandiness as quick as her target. fight.hit.officer: the master gunner's bonus (a fraction) times this raises the flagship's hit chance. fight.navy: a royal squadron of strength S sails as round(S / perShip) ships (1..maxShips). Balanced 2026-11-24 by an auto-resolve probe over ship types, crews, gunners, pirates, merchants, hunters, patrols and blockades (TODO.md). squadrons.intercept: the odds a hostile PATROL brings your ship to when its day's water comes within reach of her day's path (NavySquadrons.catchChance): base, less perHex off its track, more perShip of sail on the picket, less by night (share of the run in the dark), by the slip.weather and slip.stealth / shipStealth terms, per knot faster (speed), and peace (a realm hostile to you but not at war); clamped min..max (systems/seaInterception.js).
